\node[box, wide] (in) at (2.375,0)

\node[box] (dr) at (0,-1.05) {\textbf{depth record}, $\mathbf j_{uk}=\partial d_{uk}/\partial\boldsymbol\theta_m$\\

\node[box=sfred] (ir) at (4.75,-1.05) {\textbf{image record} $\Lambda^{I}_m$, renderer\\

\node[box] (dh) at (0,-2.15) {\textbf{cap the prior} at the repeated share\\
  $\tilde\Lambda^{D}_m=\bigl(\Sigma_\mu+(\Lambda^{D}_m)^{-1}\bigr)^{-1}$};
\node[box=sfred] (ih) at (4.75,-2.15) {\textbf{deflate the pixels}: $\hat\varphi$ from\\ frame replicates and injected $\boldsymbol\delta$};
\node[box=sfred, wide, fill=sfred!7] (t) at (2.375,-3.2)
  {\textbf{score test at the depth-placed surface}: $T_m\sim\chi^2_r$; stretch $\mathbf t_m$; $E_m=T_m/2$ [nat]};
\node[box, wide] (o) at (2.375,-4.1)
  {fused $\Lambda_m=\tilde\Lambda^{D}_m+\hat\varphi^{-1}\Lambda^{I}_m$, depth left out where $T_m$ fires;\\ unsupported by pixels in $3-r$ directions};
